title: Context Window Poisoning Benchset: Measuring Safety Degradation from Malicious Document Injection

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Addresses a real, growing attack vector in RAG systems. Systematic position/density testing fills a genuine gap. Results would directly inform defensive design of document-processing pipelines.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Document generation is scriptable in Python. Testing requires only LLM API access. No model training or GPU needed. Experimental design is straightforward (vary position, density, length). Beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 50-80 test cases with 3-5 models is well-scoped. Document generation can be templated. API calls are the main bottleneck. Achievable in 30 hours with medium compute budget for API costs.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
